notes.title: Version 1.2.2 available now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A duck can look like it is floating peacefully when just below the surface, those little legs are working overtime. 

We want you to know that lots of activity has been happening with Basketball Classics behind the scenes. Although the major release is still not quite ready, we couldn’t wait to release version 1.2.2 in time for the holidays. 

Check out the new 2020 roster, available in quick play and season mode. Along with that comes various fixes and efficiencies. 

We have heard your feedback in the forums and reviews. This release takes us one more step forward as we continue to develop robust roster editing tools. Stay tuned!

Happy holidays!

Dave and Josh
Namo Gamo

notes.title: Version 0.8.1 available now!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

A ton of big moves going on with Basketball Classics that we are excited to announce.

Roster additions:
3 new seasons have been added to the roster. That means another 240 new players spanning 48 teams, complete with new uniforms and individualized attributes. 

We hope you enjoy exploring the new 1995, 2011, and 2019 rosters. Time to hone your skills with one of your new favorite teams in Season Mode!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/43c69c890bb3115298c4f91b1a80a6b7cbd9a5ce.png

Kicks:
No, we haven’t added karate into the game. We are talking about those beloved members of the locker - Sneakers. High tops. Cross trainers. Shoes. 

Watch out for signature footwear on some of the best players in the game. Certain teams have even coordinated their styles. This is just one more way to make our players as diverse visually, as they are in ability. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/a758a722c898478a29b2670433aba5822ae1222d.png

We are fast approaching full release on Steam. It has been a pleasure to hear from you and we take your comments seriously. Let us know what you think!

notes.title: Version 0.7.3 available now!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

Hope you all had a great holiday season! 

We just pushed v0.7.3 live. It's another maintenance release as we inch closer to v0.8.0 with season and tournament modes.

I want to take a moment to thank everyone for your reviews, shares, posts, comments, podcasts, articles, streams, gameplay videos, etc. They're all so helpful and encouraging. We love all the feedback we can get and the positive reception has been unbelievable! We had an awesome year and we're looking forward to 2019 with all the challenges and opportunities it will bring! 

On with the release notes:

UPDATED
– AI tweaks: Big guys with high dunk stats now look for more openings and drive more often to the hoop for the SLAM DUNK
– Difficulty curve adjustments in the interactive dunk system
– Lots of profile pic changes & additions

BUG FIXES
– Tons of fixes in the interactive dunk system ie. bugs where Moves Remaining could potentially go below zero; dunks that appeared to be blocked ended up being successful
– Fixed missing W, X, Y, Z letters in team names on the Match Settings screen
– Fixed missing player symbols under all the players (representing stats where the player has a rating above 70)
– Fixed missing star symbols next to stats on the active/highlighted players at the top of the screen (representing when a player is the best player on their team at a particular skill ie. shooting, blocking); keep an eye on these stars for a quick overview of who your strongest players are and where they excel!

Let us know what you think! As always, find us in the Community Hub on Steam or on Twitter/Instagram @namo_gamo.

More soon!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/30d17d78e9900262baee850f4ab058ea322ad09e.jpg

notes.title: Version 0.7.2 available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I've just promoted Basketball Classics v0.7.2 from the beta branch to the live store branch. It's mostly a maintenance release to fix some lingering issues with the existing build as we focus on Season and Tournament mode for v0.8.0. We've fixed bugs, tweaked stats, added some secret hidden courts and teams, adjusted balancing, changed some profile pics, updated rosters, and added a new title screen sequence.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/0ba6c9a44721ee40c524b4b3210747ccf0f4ceed.jpg

Season and Tournament modes are feeling great and getting closer to release! They're just not quite there yet. Expect an 0.8.0 release when those new game modes are ready for the live branch.

We live in a pretty amazing era of game development where we can hop onto youtube and find footage of people playing our game from all over the world! We watch all the streams we can find in order to see how people play Basketball Classics. We watch for areas that can be improved, areas where gamers get confused, and we've even been able to spot bugs, analyze what's causing the bugs, and make fixes based on what we're seeing. Great stuff.

Thanks for playing, streaming, watching, wishlisting, and sharing! It makes all the difference in the world!

Ok, on with the release notes:

NEW
– 2 new super secret hidden unlockable courts!
– 2 new super secret hidden unlockable teams!

UPDATED
– Breathed new life into some old player profile pics/animations
– Title screen has the new logo and artwork now

BUG FIXES
– Fixed a few important bugs involving player speeds triggered by play calling
– Random fixes, including an intermittent menu crash

Please give the new changes a try and let us know what you think! As always, find us in the Steam Community Hub for Basketball Classics or on Twitter/Instagram @namo_gamo.

Talk soon!

notes.title: Version 0.7.1 available now!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Got tons of core tweaks and fixes for you here, some of which are pretty substantial. All sorts of necessary upgrades to solidify the base game as we focus on season mode, which is getting closer! If you haven't had a chance to check out the new dunk systems, give them a try and let us know what you think.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/7371d073d6e9763aeadc616d00f08988916df35b.jpg

Thanks for all your feedback! Please keep it coming! Here are the release notes:


NEW
– Get more feedback about your shot release: EARLY, VERY LATE, etc. to help you improve

UPDATED
– So many tweaks to CPU difficulty to try to ease the curve - learn on Rookie, improve with Pro, face a challenge with All-Star, cement your status with Legend
– Freezes shot meter upon release for additional feedback about your shot timing
– Updates one of the Namo Gamo fonts for increased legibility - improves visual enjoyment by 35%!
– Humanizes CPU dunk defenders - no more impossibly fast reactions
– Chasedown CPU dunk defenders slowed down - potentially outrun them on Legend, careful around C Houston 1990 though...
– Reworks shot animation speeds and timing curves to normalize shot release timings for all players in all positions on the court; in short, shooting feels better
– Reduces defender blocking radius
– Reduces defender shot contention radius
– Lowered the caps on defender's ability to contest a shot - scales with difficulty setting; example: on Rookie a defender can now only have a -20% effect on shot
– Number of CPU blocks reduced - get more shots off when defenders are near

BUG FIXES
– Wonky speed bugs triggered by passing to a pick setter before he reaches his target
– Visual glitches with the new dunk systems
– Chasedown background scrolling

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/95a667f208e7d5a9785273f74d57c9f792884316.jpg

Please give the new changes a try and holler at us with your thoughts! As always, find us in the Community Hub or on Twitter/Instagram @namo_gamo.

Talk soon!

notes.title: Version 0.7.0 available now!
notes.notes:
kschhhhh - Release v0.7.0 uhhh 9er, you are cleared for takeoff.

We are super excited to announce the biggest change yet to Basketball Classics: two brand new dynamic dunk systems! Outmaneuver your opponent in style while catching some serious hang time. Or, shock the crowd with a miraculous chasedown block. These changes not only add variety visually, but change the gameplay in a big way.

The new interactive dunk system puts you in control of the dunk, enabling you to move freely in the air to create dunks on the fly (Reverse Double Clutch, oh yeah, it's in there), all while you avoid the defender to slam it home!

We owe a huge thanks to you for the feedback within our forums, input from the NLSC group, and a fantastic write up from the Retro Sports Gamer crew. We feel these additions transform Basketball Classics and it would never have happened without your help!

Then above all, we want to send a BIG shout out to Akihiko Shimoji. As lead programmer of the masterpiece Tecmo Super Bowl, Akihiko has proven himself to be one of the leading innovators in the history of video games. We searched out his help, hoping to make Basketball Classics an impactful entry into the world of gaming. These changes were largely motivated by his humble advice and insight.

Hopefully you feel as we do, that these changes enhance the gameplay and involve players in new creative ways, while still maintaining the retro appeal that we all love!

On with the release notes:

NEW
– Two new dunk systems: interactive and chasedown!

UPDATED
– Defender improvements: smarter AI, a little bit quicker, adjustments to the speed ramp
– AI and difficulty tweaks across the board based on user feedback

BUG FIXES
– Fixes a rare crash involving timeout menus
– Bug fixes for player speeds, visual glitches, etc.

Please give it a try and let us know what you think! As always, find us in the Community Hub or on Twitter/Instagram @namo_gamo.

Talk soon!

notes.title: Version 0.6.4 available now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thanks for the recent feedback and ideas. Please keep it coming. We love hearing from you and talking basketball, retro gaming, and/or French New Wave films. Speaking of talking, we recently stopped by the awesome Basketball Guyaries podcast for an episode on the History of Basketball Video Games. It was loads of fun. Check it out here.

Now, on with the v0.6.4 patch notes. The biggest thing here is the addition of a shot clock. It's a little strange trying to put a shot clock in a retro-styled sports game where the game clock doesn't run in anything resembling the proper passage of time. Let us know if you like or hate the implementation! If you don't want it, go ahead and shut it off in the Settings menu from the title screen.

NEW
– Shot clock!
– Shot clock toggle ON/OFF in Settings (default: ON)

UPDATED
– AI updates: CPU players stay back a bit more but aren't as laggy to respond to human movements, CPU inbounding is sped up a bit, a couple changes to make Rookie difficulty just a little bit easier, several other minor tweaks to AI
– Ref makes a couple quick appearances now

BUG FIXES
– Patched a timeout menu bug

Plenty more to come. Talk soon!

notes.title: Version 0.6.3 – Wanna see something cool?
notes.notes:
We just put up version 0.6.3 but before I get into the changes I need to show you something super cool:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32503352/35897123dd36ccb6dac230b91d1814a4ad8f72c4.png

Dave just finished up the Basketball Classics game manual and it is truly a thing of beauty! 24 pages of gorgeous retro scans – staples and all. This britannica of basketball brilliance will boost your game to championship levels with its in-depth explanations of insider strategy, hints, tips, low-level algorithmic hotness, and pretty much everything you'd ever care to know about Basketball Classics.

Find it by right-clicking Basketball Classics in your Steam library and selecting "View player manual". There is also a link to download the manual right on the Basketball Classics storefront in Steam – look for the "View the manual" link.

Now, on with the patch notes:

UPDATED
– This release focuses on adjusting the difficulty curve. We've received a lot of feedback saying the game is simply too hard for a beginner. We understand the importance of getting a few wins under your belt early on. Dozens of adjustments have been made to help you out, but here are a couple of the more important ones:
– Drastically reduced the amount of jump-fake-passes the CPU throws
– The CPU team has been weakened at the dunk and jump ball mini games
– Mashing is now a bit less important in a contested dunk, giving more weight to the players' stats
– CPU players are now slowed down a bit longer when picks are set, and they are generally a little slower to react to a player's movements, allowing you more opportunities to get open and sink the J
– CPU players won't take quite as many 3's, have a harder time making many of their shots, and have to work harder to find good shots

BUG FIXES (the embarrassing part where I admit all my faults)
– Last night's 0.6.2 release (hey, it was 3am gimme a break) set the scoreboard at 10-10 until someone makes their first shot. Sorry about that.

Join the conversation in the Community Hub or on Twitter @namo_gamo

Talk soon!

notes.title: Version 0.6.2 available now!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

Thank you thank you thank you for all the positivity and support we're getting! Software launches are unavoidably stressful but reading your feedback and enthusiasm about the game has made it much easier. Please keep up the ideas, impressions, and criticism. We want to make this game as good as it can possibly be!

That said, we're happy to announce that v0.6.2 is now available for download. This patch has quite a bit so let's get to it:

NEW
– Settings area where you can adjust your Music & SFX (independently) volume levels from NONE all the way up to ELEVEN
– THE FONT - this one was big. Many of you had a hard time with the legibility of the default font. The new one adds a touch of resolution while still keeping it old school. Hope you like it!

UPDATED
– The jump ball button mash sequence has been shortened
– Steals (not pass interceptions but actual steals) have been tweaked to make them a bit easier and the distance from which a steal can be grabbed has been increased on ROOKIE difficulty
– When a dunk is contested, the initial setup of the meter is now more reflective of the respective players' stats
– Nearly all of the zipper animations that fly in over the court have been sped up to minimize their effect on court visibility
– Some of the formulas affecting game difficulty have been tweaked with a light hand. Going to address much more of these in the next 1-2 days

BUG FIXES
– Fixed an issue with the informational animation loops for Off Ball Pick and Pick 'N Roll
– Various visual glitches patched throughout

This one took too long to put together. From here on out, I plan to do smaller but more consistent updates as we go full court press toward SEASON MODE.

Join the conversation in the Community Hub or on Twitter @namo_gamo

Talk soon!
